metadata.title: How it works · Moodwave
metadata.description: From a sentence to a verified Spotify playlist: how Moodwave reads a mood, finds real records and checks every track.

attributes.text: Four quiet steps sit between the sentence you type and the playlist you press play on.
Type a moment the way you’d say it to a friend. A place, a feeling, a time of day — or something you can’t quite put into words.
Music for a slow Sunday morning, coffee and open windows
Moodwave reads between the lines — mood, energy, era, texture, tempo — and returns a structured brief, not a guess. Every pick comes with a reason.
Each suggestion is searched on Spotify and fuzzy-matched on title and artist. Anything that doesn’t really exist is thrown out and replaced, so the playlist never contains made-up songs.
You get a titled, ordered playlist with an energy arc and a one-line reason for every track. Refine it with “make it more…”, then save it straight to your Spotify.
The AI answers in a strict schema — title, artist, reason, energy — so every response is parsed, never pattern-matched out of prose.
Fuzzy matching on title and artist weeds out hallucinated tracks, duplicates and the wrong version, then backfills the gaps.
Sign-in uses OAuth with PKCE. Tokens are encrypted at rest and never leave the server; the browser only holds a signed session.
